summary: Backend adds a device-aware single-comment API with enforcement via a per-(listName, deviceId) tracker and includes a migration initializing new tracking state. Frontend adds localStorage-based deviceId plus per-list usage tracking and disables single generation after first use. However, due to truncation, the required UI behavior on backend rejection (show clear English error and ensure button ends up disabled) cannot be fully verified from the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: If the backend rejects the request due to the one-per-device-per-list rule (e.g., after clearing local storage or on a second tab), the UI shows a clear English error message and the single-generate button ends up disabled for that list.
missing_requirements.reason: CustomerViewPage.tsx catch/error-handling logic is truncated right where it appears to check the backend error message ("if (errorMessage.include..."), so the diff summary does not confirm the UI reliably detects the backend restriction error, displays the required English message, and disables the button as a result.
